To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the use of thermal imaging cameras to measure the surface temperature of seating materials is an effective way of measuring thermal characteristics of seating; and (b) there is a strong relationship between surface temperature and the temperature of the interface between the seat and subject.

the temperature at the skin surface of the human body is influenced by the material used for the seating surface, the temperature of the seating surface, and the duration of contact with that surface.

the use of a 1.5 cm thick foam pad on the seat surface, and a 2.5 cm thick pad in the lumbar region, significantly reduced the peak temperatures of the skin at the lumbar region and the buttocks, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the thermal comfort of the human body when sitting on different types of seating materials.
the development of an experimental technique for the determination of thermal characteristics at the seat-subjective interface.
the thermal characteristics of seating material.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the temperature of the seating material is not the only factor that influences thermal comfort, and that the temperature of seating materials does not necessarily correlate with the temperature of the skin at the seating interface.

the thermal properties of seating materials are not the only determining factor for thermal comfort, but rather a complex interaction between a number of variables including the material properties of the seat, the clothing of the subject, the ambient conditions of the room, the activity of the subject, and the thermal properties of the body.
The use of the seat cushion material has no significant effect on the temperature distribution at the seat-subjective interface.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the temperature of the seat is not constant.
we are trying to find a way to make the seat more comfortable by studying the heat transfer characteristics of the seat and the human body.

the temperature of seating materials has an effect on the thermal comfort of the human body, and this effect is dependent on the thermal characteristics of the materials and the position of the body on the seat.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a strong relationship between the temperature of a material and its thermal conductivity.
the temperature of the human body is not uniform.
we need to be aware of the temperature changes that occur in our body and how we can use these changes to make our body more comfortable.
